records.rule: Every phase of the finish-line sweep must produce an execution receipt under artifacts/finish-sweep/ and one scoped commit before the next phase begins.
Before every commit, verify git diff --cached --name-only contains only paths under the PurpClaw project directory. Anything else aborts the commit.
No certification gate may be made green by lowering a threshold, weakening an assertion, or reclassifying evidence. Fix the underlying defect or label the gate honestly.
Never print .env values, API keys, tokens, or vault contents into logs, receipts, events, or test output. Secret scans report paths and categories only.
